CompleteWaters: The legal entity name remains unverified. Public sources support Meaford-based ROV, sonar, sampling and monitoring services, but not engineering certification or defence deployment.
Copsys Technologies: CIDS functions are source-supported, but lifecycle-cost, signature, comparative-performance, procurement and operational-deployment claims remain unverified.
Crypto4A: NIST QASM FIPS 140-2 certificate 4250 sunsets on September 21, 2026; do not imply every current or post-quantum product inherits that validation.

CTS Containers: Current CanadaBuys evidence supports the named Dartmouth supplier, but do not claim current ISO 9001 status without the underlying certificate or extend any contract beyond its displayed term.

Curtiss-Wright Indal: Curtiss-Wright INDAL is a Mississauga operating business of U.S.-based Curtiss-Wright. Preserve the parent and legal-entity boundary; do not present it as a standalone Canadian-owned company.

D-Wave Quantum: D-Wave Quantum Inc. is Delaware-incorporated and U.S.-headquartered, with material Burnaby and Richmond R&D and manufacturing operations. Preserve that ownership and Canadian-footprint distinction; a proposed U.S. CHIPS LOI is not a final award.

Deep Trekker: SPECTRA specifications and REPMUS results are vendor-reported, and official pages differ on current handling. The packet does not treat that figure as settled or imply blanket military certification, a current CAF procurement or independent operational-effectiveness results.
DEW Engineering: The cited MSVS shelter contract expired May 8, 2026. Treat it as historical delivery evidence, not a current contract, unless a newer durable amendment is recovered.

Dominion Dynamics: Keep AuraNet Arctic sensing and AURION procurement intelligence distinct. Financing and company-reported Operation NANOOK activity do not prove deployment, procurement acceptance or current customer use.

EarthDaily Analytics: The July 2026 satellite launch and commissioning update says commercial operations are expected later in 2026; do not describe the constellation as fully operational before independent commissioning evidence.
Echo Labs: The current technical offering is supportable, but the legal entity, independent performance validation and qualified 2026 customer or procurement activity remain unresolved.

Eclipse Automation: The July 2026 expansion is independently supported. Confirm the current Accenture ownership relationship before encoding a parent edge, and do not infer defence contracts from transferable automation capability.

Edison Motors: Federal emissions authorization does not by itself establish every vehicle class, production authorization or Transport Canada safety certification. Omit the unnamed military-customer claim.

Equispheres: The federal registry shows a 2025 amalgamation and a 2026 annual filing marked overdue. Military-use and field-deployment claims remain company-authored unless independently corroborated.
Exonetik: This candidate covers Exonetik's magnetorheological actuator business. Exclude the turbogenerator grant until the relationship between Exonetik Inc. and Exonetik Turbo is resolved.

Firan Technology Group: Qualified classified-program and expected-delivery statements are issuer-reported; no named program or customer is public, and future Q3 2026 deliveries are not yet completed evidence.

FireSwarm Solutions: XPRIZE finalist and Kelowna exercise evidence supports development and testing, not full-payload operational suppression, agency adoption or completion of the planned Alaska final.
Flare: The government contribution and CRTC platform-access contract are bounded evidence. Vendor customer metrics, anonymized cases and performance claims are not independent adoption proof.

Galaxia Mission Systems: The 2027 optical and RF inter-satellite-link demonstration is planned, not deployed. Ignore the placeholder phone on the current site and do not treat issuer performance claims as independent validation.
Gastops: Cumulative delivery and F135 validation figures are vendor-reported. The legacy DND contract has confusing expiry and amendment chronology and is not current-activity evidence.

GBatteries Energy Canada: Keep the smart pulse-charging system and newer lithium-metal battery line distinct. Lithium-metal charge-time, energy-density and cycle-life metrics are vendor claims; NATO DIANA participation is not procurement or deployment.

General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada: Leave exact legalName and subsidiary relationship unresolved: procurement records can name General Dynamics Land Systems-Canada Corporation while listing GDMS-C as an operating name. Do not transfer contracts or workshare across General Dynamics entities.

General Fusion: General Fusion Inc. became a wholly owned operating subsidiary of listed B.C. parent General Fusion Group Ltd. on July 10, 2026. The June LM26 result was submitted for peer review; do not call it peer-reviewed, breakeven or commercial power.

Genoa Design International: The January 2026 Membertou and Horizon acquisition announcement was conditional, and no primary closing confirmation was found. Do not encode completed ownership; the July Arctic consortium supports current participation, not acquisition closure.

GeologicAI: Funding and the Lumo acquisition support the mining-data capability, but specific defence adoption is not established. Throughput, customer and performance statements remain vendor claims unless independently corroborated.

GeoSpectrum Technologies: GeoSpectrum is a wholly owned subsidiary of Israel-based Elbit Systems with a documented Dartmouth operation. The DND Wader contract does not prove TRAPS or Jaeger delivery, operational effectiveness, production capacity or current RCN adoption.

GHGSat: Official fleet-count material lags the July 2026 C16 and C17 launch. Do not publish a current constellation count until reconciled; detection and market-superlative claims remain attributed to the company.

GlobVision: The July 2026 IDEaS award is durable current evidence. Company and member-news claims about daily operational use, NATO participation or multi-user scope remain attributed unless matched to the exact government record.
